rows.grounds: compound naming the worship path from the right foot to the head
compound naming the corresponding left-side worship path from the head onward
indeclinable marking parallel completion of the rite

items.question: How should the practitioner sequence worship from the right foot to the head and then from the left head onward?
premises: Worship proceeds from right foot to head.
Then the left side proceeds from head onward.
items.inference: The rite prescribes a bodily circuit of worship.
uncertainties: Exact body parts and ritual direction beyond the compound hints are not explicit.
items.plain_english: Worship from the right foot up to the head, and likewise from the left head onward.
